Compare species annotations across CAMDA, NCBI, and antibiogram datasets

Source: R/compare_sp_function.R
compare_sp.Rd

This function compares species annotations from the CAMDA dataset against metadata from NCBI and antibiograms. It returns a dataset that includes consistency status between CAMDA and the external sources, as well as a comparison between the external sources themselves.

compare_sp(metadata_db = NULL, sra_metadata_db = NULL, antibiograms_db = NULL)

Arguments

metadata_db

A data frame containing CAMDA species annotations. Must include the columns: accession and scientific_name_CAMDA. Example datasets included in the package: training_metadata_db, testing_metadata_cleaned.

sra_metadata_db

A data frame containing metadata from NCBI. Must include the columns: accession and scientific_name_NCBI. A sample dataset is preloaded in the package as sra_metadata_db.

antibiograms_db

A data frame containing species annotations from antibiograms. Must include the columns: accession and scientific_name_Antibiogram. A sample dataset is preloaded in the package as antibiograms_db.

Value

A data frame with the following columns:

  • accession: Unique sample identifier.

  • scientific_name_CAMDA: Species annotation from the CAMDA dataset.

  • scientific_name_NCBI: Species annotation from NCBI metadata.

  • scientific_name_Antibiogram: Species annotation from antibiogram metadata.

  • status: Consistency between CAMDA and external sources, with values:

    Matched_NCBI_Antibiogram

    CAMDA matches both NCBI and antibiogram.

    Matched_NCBI

    CAMDA matches only NCBI.

    Matched_Antibiogram

    CAMDA matches only the antibiogram.

    Mismatch_with_CAMDA

    At least one source has data, but CAMDA does not match either.

    Missing_All

    No data available from NCBI or antibiogram.

  • status_reference: Consistency between NCBI and antibiogram sources, with values:

    Good_sources

    Both sources are present and agree.

    Verify_sources

    At least one source is present and sources disagree or are partially missing.

    No_sources

    Both NCBI and antibiogram are missing.

Examples

result <- compare_sp(metadata_db = training_metadata_db, sra_metadata_db, antibiograms_db)
